fullTextEN: The old grandpa is called Henry.
The old grandma is called Barbara.

fullTextZH: 老爷爷和老奶奶很老、很老、很老、很老。
fullTextEN: The old grandpa and old grandma are very, very, very, very old.
The old grandpa is 100 years old, 100 years old.

fullTextEN: The old grandpa and old grandma have been married for many, many years.

fullTextEN: Yes, the old grandpa and grandma thought,
